JBUpdateLayerFieldAction.description: Update one static field on an FX composition layer. `property_name` uses the same camelCase names as FX animated properties (`positionX`, `opacity`, `fillColor`, `textContent`, `sourceRange`, `description`,...). The raw JSON `value` is validated against that property before mutating the layer. Timeline placement (`activeRange`) must use the dedicated layer-timing actions so stable parent-local windows are validated and preserved. A few names address whole static structs instead of a `PropType` scalar: `shapeTrim`, `strokeDashes`, `fillPaint`, `fillBlendMode`, `mediaFit`, `blendMode`, `name`, `placement`, `justification`, `verticalAlign`, `pathOptions`, and `animators`. Two names carry extra geometry: the panel dimension writes `rectSize` and `ellipseSize` move the generator's own local origin / center so the shape resizes around the layer anchor - the anchor keeps its fraction of the box and its canvas spot, so a centered anchor grows the shape about its middle and an edge anchor holds that edge; use `animatorSetRectSize` instead when the caller is pinning an edge and has solved the placement itself. @deprecated Use the typed update action for the concrete FX layer kind.
